Q5460.reason: An employee’s out-of-court blame binds the employer only if he took part in the negligent act, and this painter had no role in the wall work, so the objection is sustained.

Q8222.reason: Fever, fatigue, and cold symptoms six weeks after OKT3 induction are the mono-like picture of EBV in a heavily immunosuppressed transplant recipient.

Q5849.reason: Testimony that computer records were kept on a regular business basis omits the rest of the Rule 803(6) and authentication foundation, so the court will require more proof of reliability.
